attributes.title: tag-read
attributes.description: Native scaffold: transport binding pending; not a deployable native MCP result implementation. Reads via system.tag.readBlocking without changing Tag values. Output contract documentation is the tag-read-output JSON Resource; discover its URI via resources/list. This Resource does not register Tool outputSchema. Intended domain output: items in requested order, each with path and status. An ok item contains value, quality and timestamp; an error item contains a canonical code/message/correlationId error. summary contains requested, succeeded and failed; meta contains correlationId only. Bad quality remains an ok data item. Missing or unrepresentable items are schema_mismatch item errors; a completed batch may contain only item errors. Supports timestampFormat iso8601 or epochMillis (case-sensitive). Example arguments: {"tagPaths":["[provider]Folder/Tag"],"timeout":5000,"timestampFormat":"iso8601"}

parameters.name: tagPaths
parameters.description: Required non-empty array of non-empty Tag path strings, in requested result order.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Optional integer milliseconds from 0 to 2147483647. Default when omitted: 5000; zero is valid.

parameters.name: timestampFormat
parameters.description: Optional timestamp format. Supported values: iso8601, epochMillis (case-sensitive). Default when omitted: iso8601. iso8601 returns UTC ISO-8601 text; epochMillis returns integer Unix epoch milliseconds. Applies to timestamps and nested Date values.
